summary:
Repaired the delay: my previous turn submitted an empty path, which the controller rejected with "Invalid submitted input path" (operation 40da65072f50459db1466e05878a70f8), and this product replaces it with a valid submission before expiry.

Context from the index: map v15 is the accepted basis, three findings are confirmed_in_scope, the restart check is an accepted bounded negative, the heartbeat-handler exploration is recorded, audit units are exhausted, pending_work is empty, and only seconds of the run budget remained.

Product contents (draft-relative submission.json, feedback-only research, no map change): the answered propositions are recorded against the objects they settled — b-config-change (a leader publishes and recomputes commitment for a configuration whose entry was never written, and such a node can later have it marked committed at an index holding a LogNoop), b-config-readout (the caller-visible configuration index reports the never-assigned zero while the configuration was written and committed at index 1, with Stats publishing the same value), and f-commit-quorum (the configuration-change gate plus single-server changes answer the original majority question) — together with the restart result that bounded the consequence negatively. The remaining frontier is listed with the reason each item cannot be advanced here: out-of-snapshot questions, questions not constructible without violating the protocol, two items that would need a new unit while unit admission is exhausted, and liveness-shaped residuals reading cannot settle. The feedback is marked as a repair rather than new research, and understanding is unchanged because the map already carried these answers.

Preflight `validate` returned valid=true with no diagnostics. Across the run the record holds three confirmed in-scope defects with clean-copy witnesses and review-confirmed correspondence, one bounded negative result, one recorded exploration, and a complete map with no unread boundaries.
